topic: What is a compounding pharmacy? Compounding explained
headline: Made to
intro: When a standard medication doesn't fit your needs, our pharmacists can prepare one that does.

points.title: What is compounding?
points.body: Preparing a medication to fit one patient's needs when a commercial product doesn't.
points.tip: It always starts with a prescription.

points.title: Why people ask for it
points.body: A different strength, a liquid instead of a tablet, a better flavour, or no dye they need to avoid.
points.tip: Handy when pills are hard to swallow.

points.title: How to get started
points.body: Ask your doctor or our pharmacists if compounding could help. A prescription is required.

points.title: What our patients say
points.quote: I originally found them when I needed a compounding pharmacy for one of my medications, and now I wouldn't go anywhere else for my medication needs.

cta_body: Ask our pharmacists. We're happy to talk through your options.
caption_instagram:
3 reasons people ask for a compounded medication 💊

Looking for a compounding pharmacy in Toronto? Our North York pharmacy near Yorkdale has a non-sterile compounding facility. Compounding means preparing a medication to fit a patient's needs when a commercial product doesn't, for example:
1️⃣ A different strength
2️⃣ A liquid instead of a tablet
3️⃣ A flavour that's easier to take, or no dye or ingredient someone needs to avoid

It can help children, older adults and people with sensitivities. A prescription is required, so ask your doctor or our pharmacists if compounding could help you.
